title: Quick Braised Greek Lamb Braise
description: A comforting Greek dish featuring lamb, potatoes, and a tangy tomato sauce. Briny, bouncy, and utterly satisfying.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shanks until browned, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and sauté the onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, wine, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Return the lamb shanks to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
While the lamb is braising, peel and dice the potatoes.
In a small bowl, mix the potato starch with a little water to make a slurry.
Add the potato slurry to the pot and stir to combine.
Serve the lamb and braising liquid over the potatoes.
